snapshot: WHO African Region. Seat of the African Union and Africa CDC. The government is pushing local production and emergency capacity while conflict in the north strains services.

leadership.name: Mekdes Daba
leadership.note: Reappointed in the October 2026 cabinet reshuffle

agenda.title: Local production of medical supplies
agenda.text: The minister says domestically made medical supplies now hold 44 percent of the home market, part of a wider push for pharmaceutical self-reliance.

agenda.title: Emergency capacity and regional solidarity
agenda.text: Ethiopia's Emergency Medical Team has deployed beyond its borders and the government has called for regional solidarity in health emergencies. Addis Ababa hosts the Conference on Public Health in Africa in November 2026.

agenda.title: Health services under conflict in the north
agenda.text: WHO's Director-General warned in early November that violence in northern Ethiopia is pushing the health system there to the brink. This is the main point of friction between the government's agenda and conditions on the ground.
